That, i. e. well-known; सा रम्या नगरी महान्स नृपतिः सामन्तचक्रं
 च तत्

The same, identical, that, very; usually with एव; तानीन्द्रियाणि सकलानि
 तदेव नाम

. Sometimes the forms of तद् are used with
 the first and second personal pronouns, as well as with demonstratives
 and relatives, for the sake of emphasis; (often translatable by ‘therefore’,
 ‘then’); सोऽहमिज्याविशुद्धात्मा

; ‘I that very person’, ‘I therefore’;
 (I who am so and so); स त्वं निवर्तस्व विहाय लज्जाम् 2. 40 ‘thou, therefore, shouldst return’
, &c. When repeated तद् has the sense of
 ‘several’, ‘various’; तेषु तेषु स्थानेषु

;
 ते ते भावाः 1. 17. तेन the instr. of तद् is often used
 with adverbial force in the sense of ‘therefore’, ‘on that account’, ‘in that case’
, ‘for that reason’. तेन हि if so, well then. ━ind.
Then, in that case, at that time.

+ -अनन्तर a. next to that. ━(ind.) immediately after that, thereupon.

 श्रोष्यसि श्रोत्रपेयम्
+ -अन्त a. perishing in that, ending thus.

+ -अर्थम् on that account, with that object, therefore; स्वस्रीयं
 मम राजेन्द्र द्रष्टुकामो महीपतिः । तदर्थमुपयातोऽहमयोध्यां रघुनन्दन ॥

+ -एकचित्त a. having the mind solely fixed on that; H.

+ -गत + .({@-तः@}) the continued multiplication of four or more like quantities.

a figure of speech (in Rhet.); स्वमुत्सृज्य गुणं योगादत्युज्ज्वलगुणस्य
 यत् । वस्तु तद्गुणतामेति भण्यते स तु तद्गुणः ॥ K.

. ˚संविज्ञानः a term applied to those Bahuvrīhi
 compounds in which the qualities denoted by the name are perceived along
 with the thing itself; as लंबकर्ण; cf. अतद्गुणसंविज्ञान also.
+ -देश्य a. coming from the same country. {@देश्यः@} a fellow countryman.

+ -धर्मिन् a. obeying his laws; तद्धर्मिणां निवसतां विषमः
 स्वभावः
+ -भव a. sprung from Sanskṛt &c. (as Prākṛt or other words).

+ -राजः an affix added to some proper names to form from them the
 names of the ‘king’ or ‘chief’; as from अङ्ग is formed आङ्ग ‘king of the Aṅgas’
 by the affix अण्.
+ -रूप a. thus shaped, so formed; of the same quality.

+ -विध a. of that kind or sort; भक्त्योपपन्नेषु हि तद्विधानां
 प्रसादचिह्नानि पुरः फलानि
an affix added to primary bases to form derivative or secondary bases from them.
a noun formed by a Taddhita affix, a derivative noun.

The rule according to which when an उत्कर्ष
 of a detail is laid down what is meant is that one should have उत्कर्ष
 not of that particular detail alone but of all the details beginning with
 that detail. In the case of अपकर्ष, however, there will be अपकर्ष
 not of that particular detail alone, but of all the details ending with
 it; तदादि उत्कर्षे तदन्तमपकर्षे गम्येत । ŚB. on
Then, at that time; नासदासीन्नो सदासीत् तदानीम्

 तदीयां सुरभेः कृत्वा प्रतिनिधिं शुचिः
Equally, in like manner, so also.

Containing or possessed of that; as in तद्वानपोहः

A मीमांसा rule of interpretation according
 to which an expression is to be considered as a नामधेय (name of
 a याग) if in the sequel is found a statement comparing the याग
 with the idea or thing expressed by that term. This rule is discussed
 by जैमिनि and शबर at
